headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth in Q2 FY27, led by TCS and HCLTech.
summary: TCS reported ₹73,188 cr revenue with a 24% operating margin and strong cash flow. HCLTech posted a 21% YoY profit rise on modest revenue growth, driven by AI sales. Several peers have not yet released results, limiting a full sector view. AI revenue is emerging as a notable growth driver.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: Both TCS and HCLTech highlighted AI revenue contributions, with HCLTech noting a 78% YoY jump.

themes.title: Revenue momentum
themes.detail: Revenue grew double‑digit YoY for TCS (15.4%) and HCLTech (11.5%).

leaders.why: Highest revenue and operating margin; strong profit and AI revenue.
Profit rose 21% YoY; AI sales highlighted as key driver.
